name: Moe Moe Ryoujoku ~Idol Ikusei Project~
original_name: 萌萌寮辱～アイドル育成プロジェクト～
source:
Heita is a third-rate cameraman, and thinks of quitting it and finding a new job. One day, he receives a job offer to work as a caretaker of a female dormitory. All the girls living there are beautiful and from rich families. He is disappointed to know that but he accidentally starts to give them sex lessons....

[From ErogeShop.com]
